comparison.objective: Depin one connector terminal vs lock a garden-hose quick coupler onto a nipple.
comparison.physical_skill: Blade-under-tab insertion followed by tool-wire pulling vs retracting a sprung collar, pushing a fitting in, and releasing the collar to lock.
comparison.success_condition: Terminal exits intact and alone vs nipple is seated, collar returned, pawl engaged, and hands clear.
comparison.reason: Both manipulate latches, but one releases an internal terminal by tool-assisted extraction while the other creates and verifies a push-lock connection.
